data.name: sharedDialog.sharedRail.helpBody
data.value:
SharedRailX settings
Velocity - Test movement velocity for this window, in mm/sec. - Saving writes it to shared_rail_x.json. A move first saves the file, then uses this value.
Pair Clearance Rule - Collision interlock criteria for this window. - Home Gap is the reference gap when both axes are at home. - A/B Sign is the encoder direction approaching the other axis: 1 for positive and -1 for negative. - Clearance = Home Gap - A Sign*A Pos - B Sign*B Pos. Movement is blocked when clearance is at or below Safety.
FrontPickerX <-> RearPickerX is not configured here. - The two pickers face each other on parallel X axes, so the Home Gap/sign method does not apply. - Simultaneous forward movement in picker Y is prevented using X Clearance in PICKER ZONE.
data.comment: GUI text only; original motion data, log content and safety formulas are preserved.
